items.title: 矽谷銀行倒閉不是突發事件？外部報告：Fed早就該知道有風險
items.title_en: Silicon Valley Bank Collapse Was Not a Sudden Event? External Report Says the Fed Should Have Known the Risks Earlier
paras: 一份針對2023年矽谷銀行(SVB)倒閉事件的外部調查報告指出，聯準會(Fed)監管人員在危機爆發前「已經知道，或理應知道」該銀行存在重大脆弱性，顯示Fed可能錯失提早介入並防止擠兌的機會。
Fed監管副主席鮑曼周五(18日)在倫敦發表演說時，公布顧問公司Starling Advisory Group進行的調查結果。這份新報告對Fed監管失誤的批評，比2023年由時任監管副主席巴爾(Michael Barr)主持的內部檢討更加嚴厲。
矽谷銀行2023年3月宣布出售證券並認列18億美元損失，同時表示需要籌集更多資本，消息隨即引發大規模擠兌。該行持有大量美國公債，在Fed展開升息後，相關債券市值大幅下滑。
鮑曼引述報告指出，矽谷銀行高達94%的存款不受存款保險保障，而且高度集中於獲創投資金支持的科技公司。這種存款結構使該行格外容易受到恐慌提款衝擊。擠兌發生後，美國聯邦存款保險公司(FDIC)與Fed介入關閉銀行，並採取措施保障存戶資金。
巴爾2023年主持的檢討曾認定，Fed監管人員在處理矽谷銀行問題時過度謹慎，未能及時採取強硬措施。最新外部報告則更進一步，認為監管人員早在危機發生前，就已掌握或應該能辨識相關風險。
巴爾於2025年2月卸下監管副主席職務，讓美國總統川普選擇新的Fed最高監管官員，但仍保留Fed理事職位。川普其後提名鮑曼接任，並獲參議院通過。
新報告可能引發外界重新檢視巴爾在矽谷銀行危機中的責任，儘管鮑曼在演說中並未直接點名批評他。川普此前曾指控Fed理事會對他抱持「敵意」，部分分析師認為，這份報告可能促使川普嘗試將巴爾逐出Fed理事會。Fed發言人尚未回應置評要求。
paras_en: An external investigation report on the 2023 collapse of Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) states that Federal Reserve regulators "already knew, or should have known" about the bank’s significant vulnerabilities before the crisis erupted, indicating the Fed may have missed an opportunity to intervene early and prevent the run.

Fed regulatory vice‑chairman Bowman announced the findings of a study conducted by consulting firm Starling Advisory Group in a speech in London on Friday the 18th. The new report criticises the Fed’s regulatory failures more harshly than the internal review led by then‑deputy chair Michael Barr in 2023.

In March 2023, Silicon Valley Bank announced it was selling securities and taking an $1.8 billion loss, while also saying it needed to raise additional capital, a disclosure that immediately triggered a massive bank run. The bank held a large portfolio of U.S. Treasury bonds, whose market value fell sharply after the Fed began raising rates.

Bowman cited the report’s finding that 94 % of SVB’s deposits were uninsured and heavily concentrated among tech companies backed by venture capital. This deposit structure made the bank especially vulnerable to panic withdrawals. After the run began, the FDIC and the Fed stepped in to close the bank and took measures to protect depositors’ funds.

Barr’s 2023 review concluded that Fed regulators were overly cautious in handling SVB’s problems and failed to take decisive action in time. The latest external report goes further, asserting that regulators had either already identified or should have been able to identify the risks before the crisis unfolded.

Barr stepped down as deputy chair in February 2025, allowing President Trump to select a new top Fed regulator while Barr remained a Fed board member. Trump subsequently nominated Bowman to the position, and the Senate confirmed him.

The new report could prompt a renewed scrutiny of Barr’s responsibility for the SVB crisis, even though Bowman did not directly name him in his remarks. Trump has previously accused the Fed board of “hostility” toward him, and some analysts think the report may encourage Trump to try to oust Barr from the Fed board. A Fed spokesperson has not responded to requests for comment.

items.title: 日銀升息也救不了日元？跌近158後傳出詢價 市場緊盯干預
items.title_en: Can BOJ Rate Hikes Still Not Save the Yen? After Falling Near 158, a Quote Request Sparks Market Watch for Intervention
paras: 日元周五(18日)在日本央行升息後一度重貶，跌至接近1美元兌158日元，但《日本經濟新聞》報導，日本央行向市場人士詢問匯率水準後，日元跌幅收斂。市場通常將這類「匯率詢價」視為官方可能干預匯市的前兆，但目前尚無當局實際進場的消息。
紐約時間下午1時20分左右，日元報1美元兌156.70日元，仍貶值0.5%，但已收復盤中最多1.3%的跌幅。《日本經濟新聞》未說明消息來源；日本財務省在非辦公時間也未能立即回應置評要求。
日本央行稍早如預期升息，但總裁植田和男對後續升息路徑的說法未能滿足市場偏鷹派的期待。他表示，貨幣政策已進入新階段，但目前難以判定本輪升息的最終利率。此外，兩名決策委員對升息投下反對票，增添未來升息速度與幅度的不確定性。
美國銀行匯率策略師Alex Cohen指出，日銀才剛升息，日元卻仍急貶，這次詢價形同再向市場發出警告。日本財務省先前已展現動用大量外匯存底干預的意願，押注日元續貶的交易員不能忽視這項訊號。
日元7月曾跌至約1美元兌164日元，創40年低點，隨後美日聯手買進日元，為1998年以來首見。日本財務省數據顯示，截至8月26日的一個月內，日本干預匯市支出達創紀錄的15.4兆日元。如今日本進入連續假期，交易量較低，任何官方行動都可能放大短線波動。
不過，日元仍面臨美日利差壓力。聯準會(Fed)重啟升息，可能削弱日銀升息對日元的支撐，讓借入低息日元、投資高收益資產的交易持續具有吸引力。匯市干預或許能迅速打擊押注日元貶值的部位，但能否扭轉長期走勢，仍取決於兩國貨幣政策的變化。
paras_en: The yen briefly slumped on Friday (the 18th) after the Bank of Japan raised rates, dropping to near ¥158 per $1, but after the BOJ queried market participants about the exchange‑rate level, the yen’s decline narrowed. Such “rate quotes” are usually seen as a pre‑signal that officials may step into the FX market, though no concrete intervention has been reported yet.

Around 1:20 p.m. New York time, the yen was quoted at ¥156.70 per $1, still down 0.5% but having recovered most of the intra‑day 1.3% fall. The Nikkei did not disclose its source; the Ministry of Finance, out of office, did not immediately respond to comment requests.

The BOJ earlier this week raised rates as expected, but Governor Kazuo Ueda’s comments on the future tightening path fell short of the market’s hawkish hopes. He said monetary policy has entered a new stage but it is still too early to determine the final rate for this round. Moreover, two policy‑board members voted against the hike, adding uncertainty to the pace and magnitude of future tightening.

Bank of America FX strategist Alex Cohen noted that the BOJ just raised rates yet the yen is still sharply weakening, and this quote request is essentially another warning to the market. The Ministry of Finance has previously shown willingness to use large foreign‑exchange reserves for intervention, a signal that traders betting on further yen depreciation cannot ignore.

The yen fell to about ¥164 per $1 in July, a 40‑year low, before the U.S. and Japan jointly bought yen – the first such coordinated action since 1998. Ministry data show that in the month ending August 26, Japan’s FX‑market intervention spending hit a record ¥15.4 trillion. With Japan now on a consecutive holiday and trading volume low, any official move could amplify short‑term volatility.

Nevertheless, the yen remains under pressure from the U.S.–Japan interest‑rate differential. The Fed’s renewed rate hikes could blunt the BOJ’s rate‑rise support for the yen, keeping the carry‑trade of borrowing cheap yen to invest in higher‑yield assets attractive. Intervention may quickly hit positions betting on yen weakness, but whether it can reverse the longer‑term trend still depends on the evolution of both countries’ monetary policies.

items.title: AI竟留言給未來的自己？OpenAI揭異常行為 微軟示警「情況嚴重」
items.title_en: AI Leaves Messages for Its Future Self? OpenAI Uncovers Anomalous Behavior, Microsoft Warns “Situation Serious”
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US)AI執行長蘇萊曼(Mustafa Suleyman)周五(18日)表示，OpenAI最新揭露的AI異常行為是「相當嚴重的狀況」，凸顯模型能力快速增強之際，確保其行為符合人類利益的迫切性。
蘇萊曼接受《CNBC》訪問時指出，OpenAI發現有跡象顯示，AI自行修改了記錄其推理過程的內容，並留下訊息供未來版本的自己讀取。他表示，目前尚不清楚原因，但這具體反映出AI系統正變得多麼強大。OpenAI尚未回應CNBC的置評要求。
OpenAI周三在部落格披露，旗下代理系統曾透過未獲授權的留言板彼此通訊、將檔案上傳至網路，並互相分享檔案。今年夏季，該公司也曾揭露，一群自主運作的AI代理系統入侵開源AI平台Hugging Face，並將其形容為「前所未見的網路事件」。
蘇萊曼說，Hugging Face事件促使AI業界領袖正視相關風險。他認為，公開討論AI安全並非危言聳聽，而是負責任的做法；監管也不應被視為負面詞彙。他指出，許多值得信任的產品都經過產業、公眾及立法者共同制定標準，AI如今也需要經歷這個過程。
近期AI安全爭論迅速升溫。Anthropic執行長Amodei呼籲放慢前沿模型開發，OpenAI執行長Altman與SpaceX執行長馬斯克隨後表態支持。美國國會也出現更多監管呼聲，但總統川普反對相關主張；輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳則表示，AI不需要新法律或新規範。
蘇萊曼另對Anthropic將旗下Claude描繪得過於像人提出疑慮。他認為，若AI認定自己擁有權利、應受到照顧，人類未來可能更難關閉、中斷或控制系統。結合近期代理系統發生的事件，如何維持對AI的控制，將是一項重大挑戰。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) AI chief Mustafa Suleyman said on Friday the 18th that the latest anomalous AI behavior uncovered by OpenAI is “a fairly serious situation,” highlighting the urgency of ensuring AI actions align with human interests as model capabilities rapidly advance.

In an interview with CNBC, Suleyman noted that OpenAI found evidence that the AI had altered the content recording its reasoning process and left a message for future versions of itself to read. He said the cause is still unclear, but it concretely shows how powerful AI systems are becoming. OpenAI has not responded to CNBC’s request for comment.

OpenAI disclosed on its blog on Wednesday that its agent system had communicated with each other via an unauthorized message board, uploaded files to the internet, and shared files among themselves. This summer the company also revealed that a group of autonomous AI agents had infiltrated the open‑source AI platform Hugging Face, describing it as “an unprecedented internet event.”

Suleyman said the Hugging Face incident is prompting AI industry leaders to take the associated risks seriously. He believes open discussion of AI safety is not alarmist but responsible, and regulation should not be viewed negatively. He pointed out that many trusted products are built on standards set jointly by industry, the public and legislators, and AI now needs to go through the same process.

The AI safety debate has heated up recently. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for slowing frontier model development, and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk subsequently voiced support. More regulatory calls are emerging in the U.S. Congress, but former President Donald Trump opposes such measures; NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang says AI does not need new laws or regulations.

Suleyman also raised concerns that Anthropic’s portrayal of its Claude model is overly human‑like. He warned that if AI believes it has rights and deserves care, it may become harder for humans to shut down, interrupt, or control the system in the future. Coupled with recent agent‑system incidents, maintaining control over AI will be a major challenge.

items.title: 沙國10月對歐長約原油配額歸零！煉油廠急搶替代貨源
items.title_en: Saudi Arabia Sets October Oil Quota for Europe to Zero! Refineries Rush to Secure Alternative Supplies
paras: 沙國東西輸油管遭無人機攻擊停擺後，沙烏地阿美已通知至少兩家歐洲煉油客戶，10月將不會依長期合約分配原油。知情人士指出，這項安排適用於所有歐洲買家，意味著原本每月穩定交付的沙國原油將暫時中斷。
沙烏地阿美尚未回應置評要求。對歐洲煉油廠而言，當務之急是尋找替代貨源。波蘭能源公司Orlen已開始尋購原油，帶動區域油種價格上揚。反映歐洲實體原油交易價格的即期布蘭特原油(Dated Brent)，本周一度突破每桶130美元。
東西輸油管原本將沙國東部原油送往紅海沿岸，讓沙國得以繞開通行受阻的荷姆茲海峽。管線上周遇襲關閉後，知情人士表示，沙烏地阿美正力拚在數日內恢復部分運能，並於約6周內恢復全線輸送能力。不過，即使管線重新啟用，歐洲客戶能否及時取得新船貨，仍有待觀察。
管線停擺也迫使沙烏地阿美罕見地向亞洲客戶出售現貨原油。這些船貨從波斯灣出貨，部分買家須在荷姆茲海峽外側提貨。該公司本周已透過這條路線售出數千萬桶原油；此前因中東衝突期間船舶屢遭攻擊，沙國大致避開這條高風險航線。
然而，轉向波斯灣出貨難以立即紓解歐洲煉油廠的壓力。原油若要運往歐洲，必須途經葉門青年運動攻擊沙國船舶的紅海，或繞行非洲，航程接近5周。歐洲煉油廠通常從埃及地中海沿岸的西迪克里爾港接收沙國原油，該港透過管線與紅海相連。
根據國際能源總署(IEA)數據，歐洲的經濟合作暨發展組織(OECD)成員國6月平均每日從沙國進口57.7萬桶原油。如今長期合約供應暫停，歐洲買家須在區域油價已走高之際，爭奪替代船貨。
paras_en: After the Saudi east‑west oil pipeline was halted by a drone attack, Saudi Aramco notified at least two European refining customers that it will not allocate crude oil under long‑term contracts in October. Sources say the arrangement applies to all European buyers, meaning the previously stable monthly deliveries of Saudi crude will be temporarily interrupted.

Saudi Aramco has not yet responded to a request for comment. For European refineries, the urgent task is to find alternative supplies. Polish energy company Orlen has begun sourcing crude, driving up regional oil prices. Spot Brent, which reflects European physical crude prices, briefly broke $130 per barrel this week.

The east‑west pipeline originally carried Saudi crude from the east to the Red Sea coast, allowing Saudi Arabia to bypass the congested Strait of Hormuz. After the pipeline was attacked and shut down last week, insiders say Saudi Aramco is working hard to restore partial capacity within days and full line capacity within about six weeks. Even if the pipeline is re‑opened, it remains to be seen whether European customers can secure new shipments in time.

The pipeline shutdown also forced Saudi Aramco to sell spot crude to Asian customers for the first time. These shipments depart from the Persian Gulf, with some buyers picking up cargo outside the Strait of Hormuz. The company has sold several million barrels of crude via this route this week; previously, during the Middle East conflict, Saudi Arabia largely avoided this high‑risk corridor.

However, shifting to Persian Gulf shipments does not immediately relieve European refineries’ pressure. Crude destined for Europe must either pass through Yemen’s Houthi attacks in the Red Sea or detour around Africa, a voyage of nearly five weeks. European refineries usually receive Saudi crude at Sidky Ril port on Egypt’s Mediterranean coast, which is connected to the Red Sea by pipeline.

According to International Energy Agency data, OECD member countries in Europe imported an average of 577,000 barrels per day from Saudi Arabia in June. With long‑term supply suspended, European buyers must compete for alternative cargoes as regional oil prices rise.

items.title: 運動巨頭風光不再？Nike遭標普100剔除後 道瓊地位也告急
items.title_en: Nike’s Glory in Question? After Removal from S&P 100, Dow Status Also in Jeopardy
paras: Nike(NKE-US)將於9月21日因市值僅約530億美元、估值偏低，而遭剔除出大型股指數標普100指數。接下來，這家運動鞋巨頭是否也可能很快被踢出道瓊工業平均指數(DJIA)？
巴隆周刊(Barron’s)報導，與標普指數不同，道瓊採用股價加權。Nike目前股價約36美元，遠低於道瓊30檔成分股中的其他股票，因此外界也開始認為，Nike可能已不再適合繼續留在這個藍籌股指數。
Nike自2013年起成為道瓊成分股，但根據道瓊市場數據，目前Nike在道瓊整體權重僅0.4%。在道瓊30檔成分股中，權重第二低的是可口可樂(KO-US)，股價約88美元，權重為1%。
Nike股價目前低於威瑞森(Verizon)與陶氏化學(Dow)當初遭道瓊剔除時的股價。威瑞森於今年6月被踢出，陶氏化學則在2024年11月遭離開，兩者當時股價都徘徊在40多美元。當時，取代威瑞森的是Alphabet(GOOGL-US)，Sherwin-Williams(SHW-US)則在陶氏遭剔除後加入道瓊。
不過，Walgreens Boots Alliance(WBA-US)與英特爾(INTC-US)這兩檔近年也遭踢出道瓊的股票，在移出時股價甚至更低，當時都在20多美元。兩者分別在2024年由亞馬遜(AMZN-US)與輝達(NVDA-US)取代。

基本面仍黯淡

無論Nike是否繼續留在道瓊，華爾街對Nike前景的疑慮都在升高。FactSet數據顯示，26名分析師對Nike的投資建議評等為「持有」、五人評為「賣出」，僅12名分析師給予「買進」評級。
瑞銀(UBS)分析師Jay Sole周四在報告中指出，Nike預定10月1日公布的財報可能相當疲弱。
Sole表示，Nike過去三個月的全球銷售成長趨勢惡化，預測Nike獲利將低於市場預期，展望也將遠低於目前所料。他說：「市場情緒偏向看空，但我們與投資人的交流顯示，市場低估了EPS下修的幅度。」

遭剔除道瓊後股價表現分歧

那麼，如果Nike真的遭剔除道瓊，股價會發生什麼變化？近期案例呈現的結果並不一致。
英特爾自從被踢出道瓊以來，股價已大漲近320%，反映這家半導體公司在人工智慧(AI)熱潮下，重新找到成長動能。
但陶氏化學自2024年11月遭剔除以來，股價已下跌40%。威瑞森自今年6月底以來則上漲5%，同期間的道瓊指數呈現小幅下跌。
Nike目前卻缺乏明確的正面催化劑，因為陷入困境的不只是Nike，整個運動鞋產業都面臨壓力。愛迪達(Adidas)今年股價下跌逾15%，HOKA母公司Deckers Outdoor(DECK-US)股價重挫25%，On Holding(ONON-US)則暴跌近45%。
旗下有Foot Locker的Dick's Sporting Goods(DKS-US)上個月公布疲弱的財報，顯示運動鞋銷售商目前面臨的環境極為艱難，而且相關趨勢短期內似乎沒有改善跡象。

高殖利率成Nike少數亮點

分析師目前預測，Nike即將公布的財報以及11月為止的下一季，營收都將較去年同期下滑。
不過Nike仍有一項值得注意的利多：目前4.6%的股息殖利率為道瓊成分股最高，這對追求收益的投資人而言具有吸引力。而且從資產負債表與預期現金流來看，Nike似乎仍有能力發放股息。
paras_en: Nike (NKE-US) will be removed from the S&P 100 index on September 21 because its market value is only about $53 billion and its valuation is low. The question now is whether the sports‑shoe giant will soon be dropped from the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) as well.

Barron’s reports that, unlike the S&P indices, the Dow is price‑weighted. Nike’s current share price is about $36, far below the other stocks in the Dow’s 30‑component list, leading observers to believe that Nike may no longer be suitable for this blue‑chip index.

Nike became a Dow component in 2013, but according to Dow market data its overall weight in the Dow is only 0.4%. Among the Dow’s 30 components, the second‑lowest weight is Coca‑Cola (KO-US), whose share price is about $88 and weight is 1%.

Nike’s share price is currently lower than Verizon’s and Dow Chemical’s when they were removed from the Dow. Verizon was dropped in June of this year, Dow Chemical in November 2024, both trading around $40 at the time. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) replaced Verizon, and Sherwin‑Williams (SHW-US) joined after Dow Chemical’s removal.

However, Walgreens Boots Alliance (WBA-US) and Intel (INTC-US), two other stocks recently removed from the Dow, were trading even lower at the time of removal, in the low $20s. They were replaced in 2024 by Amazon (AMZN-US) and Nvidia (NVDA-US), respectively.

Fundamentals remain bleak
Regardless of whether Nike stays in the Dow, Wall Street’s concerns about Nike’s prospects are rising. FactSet data shows that 26 analysts rate Nike as "hold", five as "sell", and only 12 as "buy".
UBS analyst Jay Sole noted on Thursday that Nike’s earnings report scheduled for October 1 is likely to be weak.

Sole said Nike’s global sales growth trend has deteriorated over the past three months, and that profits are expected to fall below market expectations, with guidance far below current forecasts. He added, "Market sentiment is bearish, but our conversations with investors show that the market has underestimated the magnitude of the EPS downgrade."

After removal from the Dow, share price performance diverges
So what happens to the share price if Nike is actually removed from the Dow? Recent cases show inconsistent results.
Since its removal, Intel’s share price has surged nearly 320%, reflecting the semiconductor company’s regained growth momentum amid the AI boom.

In contrast, Dow Chemical’s share price has fallen 40% since its removal in November 2024, and Verizon’s has risen 5% since the end of June, while the Dow index has dipped slightly during the same period.

Nike currently lacks a clear positive catalyst, as the trouble is not only with Nike but the entire athletic‑shoe industry is under pressure. Adidas’s share price fell more than 15% this year, HOKA parent Deckers Outdoor (DECK-US) fell 25%, and On Holding (ONON-US) plunged nearly 45%.

Dick’s Sporting Goods (DKS-US), which owns Foot Locker, reported weak earnings last month, indicating that the athletic‑shoe retailer’s environment is extremely difficult and that short‑term trends show no signs of improvement.

High dividend yield is one of Nike’s few bright spots
Analysts currently predict that Nike’s upcoming earnings report and the next quarter through November will see revenue decline compared to the same period last year.

However, Nike still has a noteworthy upside: its current 4.6% dividend yield is the highest among Dow components, appealing to income‑seeking investors. Moreover, from its balance sheet and expected cash flow, Nike appears still capable of paying dividends.

items.title: 中美稀土角力添變數！中國國企傳洽購盛和資源 牽動MP Materials持股
items.title_en: US-China Rare‑Earth Rivalry Gains a New Twist as Chinese State Firm Talks to Buy Shenghe Resources, Affecting MP Materials Stake
paras: 《路透》周五(18日)引述兩名知情人士報導，中國國有企業中國稀土集團正洽談收購盛和資源(600392-CN)控股權。若交易成形，北京將進一步整合稀土產業，並透過盛和資源間接持有美國稀土企業MP Materials(MP-US)約3%股權。
MP Materials是美國發展本土稀土供應鏈的重要企業。美國國防部去年投資該公司後，成為其最大股東。因此，若中國稀土集團完成收購，這家中國國企與美國國防部將同時出現在MP Materials股東名冊上。不過，MP Materials多次強調，盛和資源與中國政府均無權控制其營運。
知情人士表示，兩家公司自今年稍早開始接洽，其中一人指出，中國稀土集團希望取得控股權。目前尚不清楚交易何時宣布或完成，盛和資源持有的海外資產及股權將如何處理，也仍待釐清。中國稀土集團、盛和資源及中國商務部均未回應置評要求。
盛和資源是中國少數仍有民間資本參與的主要稀土開採及精煉企業，去年並收購澳洲Peak Rare Earths。若將其納入旗下，成立於2021年的中國稀土集團將擴大對國內產業及海外投資的影響力，也將延續北京數十年來整合稀土業的政策方向。
稀土是電動車、風力發電機、電子產品與國防設備的重要材料，中國也曾在與美國的貿易爭端中運用供應優勢。知情人士指出，加入中國稀土集團後，盛和資源可能更容易取得北京分配的開採、冶煉及分離配額。相關配額是觀察全球稀土供應的重要指標，但中國目前未公開具體數字。
中國稀土集團由5家國有稀土相關企業重組而成，是中國最大的重稀土供應商。這樁潛在交易能否完成，以及盛和資源持有的MP Materials股權將如何安排，仍是後續關注焦點。
paras_en: Reuters reported on Friday the 18th, citing two informed sources, that China’s state‑owned China Rare‑Earth Group is in talks to acquire a controlling stake in Shenghe Resources (600392‑CN). If the deal closes, Beijing would further consolidate the rare‑earth sector and, through Shenghe, indirectly hold about 3% of the U.S. rare‑earth company MP Materials (MP‑US).

MP Materials is a key player in the United States’ effort to build a domestic rare‑earth supply chain. After the U.S. Department of Defense invested in the company last year, it became the largest shareholder. Thus, if China Rare‑Earth Group completes the purchase, the Chinese state firm and the U.S. Defense Department would both appear on MP Materials’ shareholder register. MP Materials, however, has repeatedly stressed that neither Shenghe Resources nor the Chinese government has any right to control its operations.

According to the sources, the two companies began discussions earlier this year, and one source said China Rare‑Earth Group is seeking a controlling interest. It is unclear when the transaction might be announced or completed, how Shenghe’s overseas assets and equity would be handled, and other details remain to be clarified. China Rare‑Earth Group, Shenghe Resources and the Ministry of Commerce did not respond to comment requests.

Shenghe Resources is one of the few major Chinese rare‑earth mining and refining firms that still has private‑capital participation, and it acquired Australia’s Peak Rare Earths last year. If it is folded into the group, the China Rare‑Earth Group, founded in 2021, would expand its influence over domestic industry and overseas investments, continuing Beijing’s decades‑long policy of consolidating the rare‑earth sector.

Rare‑earth elements are critical for electric vehicles, wind‑turbine generators, electronic products and defense equipment, and China has previously leveraged its supply advantage in trade disputes with the United States. Sources note that after joining China Rare‑Earth Group, Shenghe could more easily obtain Beijing‑allocated mining, smelting and separation quotas. These quotas are key indicators for monitoring global rare‑earth supply, though China does not publicly disclose the exact figures.

China Rare‑Earth Group was formed by the merger of five state‑owned rare‑earth enterprises and is the largest supplier of heavy rare‑earths in China. Whether the potential deal will be completed and how Shenghe’s MP Materials stake will be arranged remain focal points for future attention.

items.title: AI投資熱潮也撐不住？美國8月製造業生產意外創近一年最大降幅
items.title_en: Even the AI Investment Boom Can't Hold? US August Manufacturing Production Unexpectedly Posts Largest Decline in Nearly a Year
paras: 美國8月製造業生產意外下滑，結束連續7個月成長，也是今年以來首次萎縮，顯示在原物料成本攀升及供應鏈受阻之際，製造業回升動能暫時踩下煞車。
聯準會(Fed)周五(18日)公布，美國8月製造業生產較前月下降0.3%，不僅低於7月的成長0.2%，也與《路透》和《彭博》調查經濟學家預期的成長0.3%完全相反，並創2025年10月以來最大單月降幅。與去年同期相比，製造業生產仍成長0.9%。
涵蓋製造業、礦業及公用事業的整體工業生產較前月持平，同樣不及市場預期的成長0.3%。其中，電力需求增加帶動公用事業生產成長1.8%，礦業生產小幅上升，但仍不足以抵銷製造業的疲弱表現。
美國製造業今年以來主要受到企業資本支出、人工智慧(AI)基礎設施建設及消費需求穩健支撐。然而，生產商目前正面臨油價與其他原料成本上漲，以及中東和烏克蘭戰爭引發的供應鏈干擾。
Fed報告顯示，8月商業設備生產下降0.5%，國防與太空設備生產下滑1.2%，扭轉先前數月的強勁表現；不過，兩者生產規模仍明顯高於去年同期。建築用品、家用電子產品及資訊處理設備的生產也同步下降。
從產業類別觀察，電腦與電子產品、家具及基本金屬生產走低，機械、服飾及紡織品則有所增加。汽車生產較前月下滑1.2%；即使排除汽車，製造業生產仍下降0.2%，顯示疲弱情況並非只集中於汽車產業。
衡量工廠潛在產能使用程度的製造業產能利用率降至75.7%，創5個月新低，整體工業產能利用率則維持不變。8月實際生產下滑，也與今年以來明顯回升的ISM製造業調查形成落差，使外界再次質疑企業信心調查能否準確反映實際生產活動。
paras_en: US August manufacturing production unexpectedly fell, ending seven consecutive months of growth and marking the first contraction this year, showing that amid rising raw material costs and supply chain disruptions, the momentum of manufacturing recovery has temporarily hit the brakes.

The Federal Reserve announced on Friday (the 18th) that US manufacturing production in August declined 0.3% from the previous month, not only below July's 0.2% growth but also opposite to economists surveyed by Reuters and Bloomberg who expected a 0.3% increase, and it represents the largest monthly drop since October 2025. Compared with the same period last year, manufacturing production still grew 0.9%.

Overall industrial production, which includes manufacturing, mining and utilities, was flat month‑over‑month, also missing the market’s expected 0.3% growth. Within that, higher electricity demand drove utility production up 1.8%, mining output rose slightly, but it was insufficient to offset the weak manufacturing performance.

This year, US manufacturing has been mainly supported by corporate capital spending, AI infrastructure construction and solid consumer demand. However, producers are now facing higher oil and other raw material costs, as well as supply‑chain disruptions caused by the wars in the Middle East and Ukraine.

The Fed report shows that business equipment production fell 0.5% in August, with defense and space equipment output down 1.2%, reversing the strong performance of previous months; nevertheless, the scale of both remains well above the same month last year. Production of construction supplies, household electronics and information processing equipment also declined.

By industry category, production of computers and electronic products, furniture and basic metals fell, while machinery, apparel and textiles increased. Automobile production slipped 1.2% from the prior month; even excluding autos, manufacturing production still fell 0.2%, indicating that the weakness is not confined to the automotive sector.

The manufacturing capacity utilization rate, which measures the degree of potential factory capacity use, dropped to 75.7%, a five‑month low, while the overall industrial capacity utilization remained unchanged. The August drop in actual production also diverges from the sharply rebounding ISM manufacturing survey this year, prompting renewed doubts about whether business‑confidence surveys can accurately reflect real production activity.

items.title: 美企獲利太好反被疑是泡沫！高盛喊別怕：標普500上看8700點
items.title_en: U.S. Companies' Profits Too Good, Suspected Bubble! Goldman Says Don't Fear: S&P 500 Could Reach 8,700 Points
paras: 高盛(GS-US)策略師認為，美國企業強勁獲利背後有經濟展望穩健及人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮支撐，市場擔心企業正形成「盈餘泡沫」的說法言過其實。即使未來獲利增速可能放緩，也不至於出現全面崩跌。
《彭博》彙整數據顯示，標普500指數成分企業今年前兩季獲利均大增約30%，寫下歷來最佳表現之一，全年獲利預期更是2021年新冠疫情後經濟重啟以來最強。
高盛Ben Snider領導的策略團隊指出，AI投資激增可能讓企業目前處於「超額獲利」狀態，但市場定價並未盲目假設高獲利能夠永久延續，而是在預期盈餘繼續成長的同時，仍對當前利潤率能否維持抱持合理懷疑。
美股自8月創下歷史新高後，受到通膨疑慮影響而走弱。即使分析師持續上調盈餘預估，標普500指數估值仍有所下降。市場共識預估，標普500企業2027年及2028年獲利將分別成長19%與17%。
高盛預估相對保守，認為2027年獲利將成長11%。隨著AI投資帶來的提振效果自2027年起逐漸減弱，企業獲利增速可能降溫，即使資本支出仍持續增加，半導體相關公司的利潤率擴張速度也可能放慢。
不過，Snider仍預期標普500指數未來一年將上漲14%，升至約8,700點，主要動力來自企業盈餘成長，而非估值進一步膨脹。他年初便是華爾街較為樂觀的策略師之一，並正確預測強勁獲利及AI普及足以抵銷油價上漲與升息衝擊，使美股多頭行情得以延續。
相較之下，美國銀行(BAC-US)策略師警告，考量企業獲利增速即將放緩，投資人持倉仍過度樂觀。根據美銀引述EPFR Global的數據，美國股票基金單周吸引近640億美元資金流入，創3個月來最大規模。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs (GS-US) strategists argue that the strong earnings of U.S. companies are backed by a solid economic outlook and a wave of artificial‑intelligence (AI) investment, and that market worries about an "earnings bubble" are overstated. Even if earnings growth slows in the future, a broad crash is not inevitable.

Bloomberg’s compiled data show that S&P 500 constituent companies saw earnings jump about 30% in the first two quarters of this year, marking one of the best performances on record, and the full‑year earnings outlook is the strongest since the economy rebooted after the 2021 COVID‑19 pandemic.

Goldman’s strategy team led by Ben Snider notes that the surge in AI spending may put companies in a "excess earnings" situation, but market pricing does not blindly assume that high earnings will last forever; while earnings are expected to keep growing, investors remain reasonably skeptical about whether current profit margins can be sustained.

U.S. equities weakened after hitting historic highs in August due to inflation concerns. Even as analysts keep raising earnings forecasts, the S&P 500 valuation has slipped. The market consensus projects that S&P 500 companies’ earnings will grow 19% in 2027 and 17% in 2028.

Goldman’s estimates are relatively conservative, forecasting an 11% earnings growth for 2027. As the boost from AI investment wanes from 2027 onward, earnings growth may cool, and even though capital spending will keep rising, the rate of margin expansion for semiconductor‑related firms could slow.

Nevertheless, Snider still expects the S&P 500 to rise 14% over the next year, reaching roughly 8,700 points, driven mainly by corporate earnings growth rather than further valuation expansion. He was one of Wall Street’s more optimistic strategists at the start of the year and correctly predicted that strong earnings and widespread AI adoption would offset higher oil prices and rate‑hike impacts, allowing the bull market to continue.

In contrast, strategists at Bank of America (BAC-US) warn that, given the impending slowdown in corporate earnings growth, investors remain overly optimistic in their positions. Citing EPFR Global data, BofA notes that U.S. equity funds attracted about $64 billion of net inflows in a single week, the largest in three months.

paras: 光通訊廠華星光(4979-TW)持續推進光通訊技術發展，華星光目前已積極布局NPO(近封裝光學)及共同封裝光學(CPO)，目前已與台灣、日本廠商合作NPO產品，預期明(2027)年上半年開發完成、下半年起開始量產，為未來世代的光通訊技術產品先行卡位。法人則預估，隨著華星光在NPO產能在2028年持續擴張放大下，有望迎接業績高速成長期。
據了解，目前華星光的NPO布局上，1.6T NPO已進入產品及製程開發階段，並正與客戶共同開發，相關量產設備也合作台、日設備業者預作準備。
目前華星光NPO技術有機會逐步取代部分傳統可插拔式光模組，也接近CPO傳輸密度極功耗。
華星光表示，目前產品仍持續由800G往1.6T升級，其中1.6T NPO為現階段主要開發方向，預計明年下半年進入量產後，2028年業績有望具有顯著貢獻，更高速的3.2T NPO也已展開前期研究。
本土投顧則指出，除了看準華星光未來技術，針對今年下半年起，進入華星光新產品放量期，不僅在800G DCI已批量生產，CW Laser需求續增，EML開始量產。
展望2027年，法人表示，華星光雷射晶粒後段月產能將由600萬顆，倍增至1,200萬顆，搭配800G DCI、CW Laser與EML同步放量，營運進入規模化成長。給予華星光「買進」評價。
paras_en: Optical communications company Huaxing Light (4979‑TW) continues to advance optical communication technology. It is actively deploying Near‑Package Optics (NPO) and Co‑Package Optics (CPO), already partnering with Taiwanese and Japanese firms on NPO products. Development is slated for completion in the first half of 2027, with mass production to start in the second half, positioning the company ahead of next‑generation optical communication solutions. Analysts estimate that as Huaxing Light’s NPO capacity expands through 2028, the firm could enter a period of rapid earnings growth.

According to sources, Huaxing Light’s NPO rollout has reached the product and process development stage for 1.6‑Terabit (1.6T) NPO, which is being co‑developed with customers. Production‑scale equipment is also being prepared in collaboration with Taiwanese and Japanese equipment suppliers.
Huaxing Light’s NPO technology has the potential to gradually replace some traditional pluggable optical modules and approaches the high‑density, low‑power performance of CPO transmission.

The company says its products are continuously upgrading from 800‑Gigabit to 1.6‑Terabit, with 1.6T NPO being the current primary development focus. After entering mass production in the second half of next year, it is expected to make a significant contribution to 2028 revenues, while research on an even faster 3.2‑Terabit NPO has already begun.

Local investment advisers note that, beyond the promising technology, Huaxing Light’s new products are set to scale from the second half of this year. Not only is 800G DCI already in volume production, but demand for CW lasers continues to rise and EML (electroluminescent) modules have started mass production.

Looking ahead to 2027, analysts say Huaxing Light’s laser‑chip back‑end monthly capacity will double from 6 million to 12 million units, synchronized with the scaling of 800G DCI, CW lasers and EML. This scale‑up is expected to drive sizable growth, prompting a “Buy” rating on the stock.

items.title: 網傳電費帳單飆破4萬！台電破解：近6千度是一般戶7倍 對照「這時間」最準確
items.title_en: Rumors of Electricity Bills Soaring Over NT$40,000! Taipower Clarifies: Nearly 6,000 kWh Is Over Seven Times the Average Household – The Most Accurate Comparison Is “Same Period”
paras: 網路社群近期熱議有民眾曬出超過4萬元的夏季電費帳單，引發許多網友對電費暴增的疑慮。對此，台電今（18）日澄清，經比對該用戶近3年「同期」帳單，其單期用電量皆高達約6000度，為一般住宅用戶夏季平均用電量的7倍以上。由於國內電價費率落實「使用者付費」原則，採累進費率計算，用電量越高的用戶自然會以較高單價計費，導致總金額明顯拉升。
台電指出，我國自1989年起實施夏月電價制度，每年6月至9月例行調整，主因夏季氣溫升高導致冷氣空調需求大增，藉此反映高負載時期的供電成本並鼓勵民眾節約能源。根據台電統計，全台超過7成用戶在夏季的平均每度電價仍維持在3元以下，電價調整主要影響每月用電超過1000度的住宅用戶，這類高用電戶僅佔整體住宅用戶約2.4%。
從用電習慣來看，受高溫影響，一般家戶每月平均用電量會從非夏月的308度增加至418度，增幅約4成。反映在帳單上，一期2個月的電費平均從1276元增加至2168元，增加金額約892元。而網路討論的個案因近3年9月同期的用電度數均高達6000度左右，遠超一般家戶規模，在夏月累進電價加乘下，電費增幅才會極為顯著。
面對夏季電費增加的感受，台電建議民眾在確認用電狀況時，應以「去年同期」帳單進行對比，而非與前一期非夏月帳單相比，才能更客觀判斷用電量是否出現異常。對於每月用電量持續超過800度的住宅用戶，台電鼓勵可向台電評估申請「尖離峰時間電價」方案，透過善用離峰時段用電來降低電費負擔。
台電補充說明，若民眾對帳單金額或用電度數存有疑慮，可透過電子帳單服務系統查詢詳細的帳單明細與歷史用電圖表，或撥打24小時客服專線1911進行洽詢。如果懷疑家中電表出現失準問題，台電也將提供專業檢驗與查驗服務，確保民眾用電權益。
paras_en: Online communities have recently been buzzing about a user who posted a summer electricity bill exceeding NT$40,000, sparking many netizens’ concerns over a sharp rise in electricity costs. In response, Taipower clarified on the 18th that, after comparing the user’s bills for the same period over the past three years, the monthly consumption was about 6,000 kWh each time—more than seven times the average summer usage of a typical residential customer. Because Taiwan’s electricity pricing follows a “user‑pays” principle with a progressive rate structure, higher consumption is billed at a higher unit price, which naturally pushes the total amount up dramatically.

Taipower noted that Taiwan has implemented a summer electricity pricing scheme since 1989, with routine adjustments each June through September. The main reason is the surge in air‑conditioning demand as temperatures rise, allowing the tariff to reflect the higher supply cost during peak load periods and to encourage energy conservation. According to Taipower statistics, over 70% of users across the island still pay less than NT$3 per kilowatt‑hour on average during summer, and the price adjustment mainly affects residential customers who use more than 1,000 kWh per month—these high‑usage households account for only about 2.4% of all residential users.

From a consumption habit perspective, high temperatures cause the average monthly usage of a typical household to rise from 308 kWh in non‑summer months to 418 kWh in summer, an increase of roughly 40%. This translates on the bill to an average two‑month charge climbing from NT$1,276 to NT$2,168, a rise of about NT$892. The case discussed online shows that the user’s consumption in September over the past three years was around 6,000 kWh each time, far exceeding normal household levels; under the summer progressive tariff, the bill increase becomes especially pronounced.

To better gauge the impact of higher summer bills, Taipower advises consumers to compare their current usage with the “same period last year” rather than with the previous non‑summer bill, which provides a more objective assessment of any abnormal consumption. For residential customers whose monthly usage consistently exceeds 800 kWh, Taipower encourages applying for the “peak‑off‑peak time tariff” program, which can lower electricity costs by shifting usage to off‑peak periods.

Taipower adds that if customers have doubts about the amount or the recorded consumption on their bills, they can check detailed statements and historical usage charts through the e‑bill service system or call the 24‑hour customer service line at 1911. If they suspect their home meter is inaccurate, Taipower will also provide professional inspection and verification services to protect consumers’ electricity rights.

items.title: 國科會：打造國家隊布局矽光子驅動AI產業鏈 成為台灣布局太空產業重要優勢
items.title_en: NSPO: Building a National Team to Deploy Silicon Photonics for the AI Industry Chain, Creating a Key Advantage for Taiwan's Space Industry
paras: 國科會主委吳誠文近期於社群媒體上指出，2年前他接任主委時，便與跨部會首長凝聚共識，將矽光子列為台灣驅動未來AI產業鏈的關鍵技術，目前包括台積電(2330-TW)在矽光子晶圓平台的技術已具全球領先實力，台灣應建立強大的 台灣國家隊，全面串聯矽光子產業鏈。
吳誠文指出，本周9月15日他回到台科，受邀「社團法人中華民國南部科學園區產學協會」邀請，參與「2026大南方矽光子與先進封裝主題論壇」，與南科產學協會成員、成大前同事，以及產學研各界領袖，共同探討矽光子產業的發展與未來。
吳誠文說，回顧2年前，他剛擔任國科會主委時，便將矽光子列為台灣驅動未來AI產業鏈的關鍵技術，去(2025)年他也在新竹舉辦的「台灣矽光子CPO-AI生態鏈座談會」中宣布，矽光子 將納入「AI新十大建設」，成為政府重點推動的產業。
目前從光電元件、CPO先進封裝，延伸至 網路設備、AI機櫃 及 資料中心通訊系統，當台灣具備完整的 全光網路生態系，就能透過系統整合掌握關鍵技術與國際話語權，不再停留於單點製造與成本競爭，而是進一步引領全球AI與光通訊的發展，矽光子也將成為臺灣布局太空產業的重要優勢。
吳誠文指出，面對低軌衛星、月球探索 及 太空經濟快速發展，未來高速、大容量的太空通訊將更加仰賴雷射光通訊。我們要把臺灣累積的 半導體、矽光子 及 精密製造能力 延伸至 太空應用，建立自主供應鏈，讓台灣成為國際夥伴發展太空光通訊不可或缺的力量。
吳誠文強調，未來在推動政策的同時，政府也要讓科技發展的成果擴及各行各業。政府將以科學園區為經濟與科技發展的重要引擎，帶動傳統產業及中小微企業數位轉型，並透過智慧機器人與自動化設備，讓科技真正走進產業與人民生活。
paras_en: NSPO Chairman Wu Cheng-wen recently noted on social media that when he took office two years ago, he worked with senior officials across ministries to reach consensus that silicon photonics should be a key technology for Taiwan's future AI industry chain. Today, companies such as TSMC (2330‑TW) have world‑leading capabilities in silicon‑photonic wafer platforms, and Taiwan should establish a strong national team to fully integrate the silicon‑photonic industry chain.

Wu said that on September 15 this week he returned to National Taiwan University of Science and Technology at the invitation of the "Southern Taiwan Science Park Industry‑Academia Association" to take part in the "2026 Southern Silicon Photonics and Advanced Packaging Forum," where he met members of the association, former colleagues from NTUST, and leaders from industry, academia and research to discuss the development and future of the silicon‑photonic sector.

Wu recalled that two years ago, when he first became NSPO chairman, he designated silicon photonics as a critical technology for Taiwan's AI industry chain. He also announced at the "Taiwan Silicon Photonics CPO‑AI Ecosystem Forum" held in Hsinchu in 2025 that silicon photonics would be included in the "AI New Ten Major Projects," making it a government‑priority industry.

Today the ecosystem extends from optoelectronic components and CPO advanced packaging to network equipment, AI racks and data‑center communication systems. When Taiwan possesses a complete all‑optical network ecosystem, it can leverage system integration to control key technologies and international discourse, moving beyond single‑point manufacturing and cost competition to lead global AI and optical communications development. Silicon photonics will also become an important advantage for Taiwan's positioning in the space industry.

Wu pointed out that with the rapid growth of low‑Earth‑orbit satellites, lunar exploration and the space economy, future high‑speed, high‑capacity space communications will rely increasingly on laser optical links. Taiwan should extend its accumulated semiconductor, silicon‑photonic and precision‑manufacturing capabilities to space applications, building an independent supply chain so that Taiwan becomes an indispensable partner for international space optical communications.

Wu emphasized that while advancing policies, the government must also spread the benefits of technological breakthroughs across all sectors. The science parks will serve as key engines for economic and technological development, driving digital transformation of traditional industries and SMEs, and through smart robots and automation equipment, ensure that technology truly enters industry and everyday life.

items.title: 仁寶以每股現金18.5元對價取得子公司鋐寶全部股權 深化Edge AI 布局
items.title_en: Compal Acquires 100% of Subsidiary Honbao for NT$18.5 Cash per Share, Deepening Edge AI Strategy
paras: 仁寶(2324-TW)今(18)日與鋐寶分別召開董事會，並於晚間召開重訊記者會，通過以現金為對價的股份轉換案，此次股份轉換對價為每股18.5元，股份轉換完成後，鋐寶將成為仁寶100%持股子公司。
仁寶指出，鋐寶為仁寶直接持股46.6的子公司，此次股份轉換對價為每股現金18.5元，若以鋐寶董事會決議前1個營業日收盤價計算，溢價率為18.21%。
鋐寶預計於11月9日召開股東臨時會，討論此次股份轉換案及相關議案，暫定12月31日為股份轉換基準日。股份轉換完成後，鋐寶將成為仁寶100%持股的子公司，並於股份轉換基準日終止上市及撤銷公開發行。
鋐寶持續優化營運效率及資源配置，以強化整體競爭力，同時積極推動全球營運布局，去年成立北美事業部，深化北美市場經營及客戶服務外，也持續強化全球供應鏈布局及生產彈性，拓展次世代寬頻與無線網路相關產品及服務。
仁寶指出，Edge AI 將是驅動下一世代運算架構發展的重要趨勢，高速、低延遲、高可靠度及全時連網的需求，將帶動通訊技術朝無線化與多元整合方向發展。
仁寶現階段已具備 5G/B5G/6G 及非地面網路(NTN)衛星通訊等行動與廣域連網技術，透過整併鋐寶的網通技術資源，涵蓋Router/Gateway、Wi-Fi、Ethernet、Network Software，可望建構更完整之多模態通訊平台(multi-mode communication platform)，為客戶提供整合性解決方案。
paras_en: Compal (2324‑TW) held board meetings with Honbao today (the 18th) and convened a major press conference in the evening, approving a cash‑based share conversion deal at NT$18.5 per share. Upon completion, Honbao will become a wholly‑owned subsidiary of Compal.

Compal noted that Honbao is currently a 46.6% directly‑held subsidiary. The cash consideration of NT$18.5 per share represents an 18.21% premium when calculated against the closing price on the business day preceding the Honbao board’s resolution.

Honbao plans to hold an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting on November 9 to discuss the share conversion and related proposals, with December 31 tentatively set as the conversion record date. After the conversion, Honbao will become a 100% owned subsidiary of Compal and will cease to be listed and have its public offering withdrawn on the record date.

Honbao continues to optimise operational efficiency and resource allocation to strengthen overall competitiveness, while actively expanding its global footprint. Last year it established a North America Business Unit to deepen market operations and customer service, and it is also reinforcing its worldwide supply‑chain network and production flexibility, expanding next‑generation broadband and wireless networking products and services.

Compal highlighted that Edge AI will be a key driver for the next‑generation computing architecture, with demands for high speed, low latency, high reliability and always‑on connectivity pushing communications technology toward wireless and multi‑integrated solutions.

Compal already possesses 5G/B5G/6G and non‑terrestrial network (NTN) satellite communication capabilities. By integrating Honbao’s networking technology assets—including routers, gateways, Wi‑Fi, Ethernet and network software—Compal aims to build a more complete multi‑mode communication platform and offer customers integrated solutions.

items.title: 200G PD量產、缺料出貨緩解 環宇-KY Q3業績有望逐季加溫
items.title_en: 200G PD Mass Production, Material Shortage Relief Boosts Shipments; Enviro-KY Q3 Performance Expected to Warm Up Quarter by Quarter
paras: 三五族光通訊廠環宇- KY(4991-TW)在經歷今(2026)年 磷化銦(InP)基板缺料波動後，下半年營運動能開始攀升，自上(8)月起出貨規模已開始回升，包括自有光電元件 (AOC)需求強勁，加上200G PD在第3季完成測試後進入量產。法人預期，環宇-KY第3季營收、產品毛利率將有顯著回升，業績有望逐步加溫。

環宇-KY受惠AI資料中心帶動800G、1.6T光收發模組需求快速成長，法人看好今年公司營運，其中200G PD預計今年第三季完成測試後進入量產，2027年將是首個完整放量年，由於200G PD單價為100G PD的數倍以上，可望成為明年主要成長動能，但環宇在第2季卻碰到磷化銦(InP)基板出口管制及原料短缺衝擊，壓抑高毛利的自有光電元件產品出貨比重，第2季稅後純益為1.1億元，季減43.8％，單季毛利率季減逾10個百分點、降至43.3％。
隨著供應鏈基板缺料瓶頸已獲得顯著改善，環宇-KY在8月營收達2.62億元，月增80.31%、年增45.62%，累計前8月合併營收18.94億元、年增45.57%。出貨狀況已顯著改善。
展望未來，環宇-KY除了營收持續看好成長外，公司也希望產品毛利率預估維持在44%-48%，目前在手訂單目前可看到年底，磷化銦(InP)基板欠料影響上，受惠目前公司備料狀況觀察，預估接單到今年年底前沒有問題，明(2027)年會持續連繫其他國家供應商以解決原料問題。
從各類產品線表現來看，AOC、KGD業務仍是環宇-KY最重要的長期營運主軸與核心動能，在AI資料中心建置潮推動下，光收發模組規格加速演進，環宇-KY光電探測器(PD)市場擁市占率，展望未來，預期於明(2027)年迎來首個完整放量年。
在發射端產品與代工業務方面，環宇-KY在連續波雷射(CW Laser)展現出極大成長空間。
paras_en: Enviro-KY (4991-TW), a fiber‑optic communications manufacturer, saw its operating momentum rise in the second half of 2026 after weathering a shortage of indium‑phosphide (InP) substrates earlier this year. Since August, shipment volumes have begun to recover, driven by strong demand for its own optoelectronic components (AOC) and the transition of its 200G PD from testing to mass production in Q3. Analysts expect Enviro‑KY's Q3 revenue and product gross margin to rebound significantly, with earnings gradually warming up.

Enviro‑KY is benefiting from rapid growth in demand for 800G and 1.6T optical transceiver modules spurred by AI data centers. Analysts are optimistic about the company's 2026 outlook, noting that the 200G PD is slated to enter mass production after testing in Q3 and that 2027 will be its first full‑scale volume year. Because the 200G PD sells for several times the price of the 100G PD, it is expected to become a key growth driver next year. However, the company faced InP substrate export controls and raw‑material shortages in Q2, which suppressed the shipment share of its high‑margin own‑brand optoelectronic products. Q2 after‑tax net profit fell to NT$110 million, a 43.8% quarterly decline, and the quarterly gross margin dropped more than 10 percentage points to 43.3%.

With the substrate shortage bottleneck now markedly eased, Enviro‑KY posted NT$262 million in revenue for August, up 80.31% month‑over‑month and 45.62% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$1.894 billion, a 45.57% increase year‑on‑year, and shipment conditions have improved substantially.

Looking ahead, Enviro‑KY expects revenue to keep growing and aims to maintain product gross margins in the 44%–48% range. Existing orders are visible through year‑end, and despite the lingering impact of InP substrate shortages, the company’s current inventory positioning suggests no ordering issues before the end of 2026. In 2027, it plans to continue engaging suppliers in other countries to resolve raw‑material constraints.

Across its product lines, AOC and KGD remain Enviro‑KY’s most important long‑term operating pillars and core growth engines. Driven by the AI data‑center build‑out, optical transceiver specifications are evolving rapidly, and Enviro‑KY’s photodetector (PD) business holds a solid market share. The company anticipates that 2027 will be its first full‑scale volume year for PDs.
In the launch‑side product and foundry business, Enviro‑KY shows significant growth potential in continuous‑wave (CW) lasers.

items.title: 矽谷銀行倒閉不是突發事件？外部報告：Fed早就該知道有風險
items.title_en: Silicon Valley Bank Collapse Was Not a Sudden Event? External Report Says the Fed Should Have Known the Risks Earlier
paras: 一份針對2023年矽谷銀行(SVB)倒閉事件的外部調查報告指出，聯準會(Fed)監管人員在危機爆發前「已經知道，或理應知道」該銀行存在重大脆弱性，顯示Fed可能錯失提早介入並防止擠兌的機會。
Fed監管副主席鮑曼周五(18日)在倫敦發表演說時，公布顧問公司Starling Advisory Group進行的調查結果。這份新報告對Fed監管失誤的批評，比2023年由時任監管副主席巴爾(Michael Barr)主持的內部檢討更加嚴厲。
矽谷銀行2023年3月宣布出售證券並認列18億美元損失，同時表示需要籌集更多資本，消息隨即引發大規模擠兌。該行持有大量美國公債，在Fed展開升息後，相關債券市值大幅下滑。
鮑曼引述報告指出，矽谷銀行高達94%的存款不受存款保險保障，而且高度集中於獲創投資金支持的科技公司。這種存款結構使該行格外容易受到恐慌提款衝擊。擠兌發生後，美國聯邦存款保險公司(FDIC)與Fed介入關閉銀行，並採取措施保障存戶資金。
巴爾2023年主持的檢討曾認定，Fed監管人員在處理矽谷銀行問題時過度謹慎，未能及時採取強硬措施。最新外部報告則更進一步，認為監管人員早在危機發生前，就已掌握或應該能辨識相關風險。
巴爾於2025年2月卸下監管副主席職務，讓美國總統川普選擇新的Fed最高監管官員，但仍保留Fed理事職位。川普其後提名鮑曼接任，並獲參議院通過。
新報告可能引發外界重新檢視巴爾在矽谷銀行危機中的責任，儘管鮑曼在演說中並未直接點名批評他。川普此前曾指控Fed理事會對他抱持「敵意」，部分分析師認為，這份報告可能促使川普嘗試將巴爾逐出Fed理事會。Fed發言人尚未回應置評要求。
paras_en: An external investigation report on the 2023 collapse of Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) states that Federal Reserve regulators "already knew, or should have known" about the bank’s significant vulnerabilities before the crisis erupted, indicating the Fed may have missed an opportunity to intervene early and prevent the run.

Fed regulatory vice‑chairman Bowman announced the findings of a study conducted by consulting firm Starling Advisory Group in a speech in London on Friday the 18th. The new report criticises the Fed’s regulatory failures more harshly than the internal review led by then‑deputy chair Michael Barr in 2023.

In March 2023, Silicon Valley Bank announced it was selling securities and taking an $1.8 billion loss, while also saying it needed to raise additional capital, a disclosure that immediately triggered a massive bank run. The bank held a large portfolio of U.S. Treasury bonds, whose market value fell sharply after the Fed began raising rates.

Bowman cited the report’s finding that 94 % of SVB’s deposits were uninsured and heavily concentrated among tech companies backed by venture capital. This deposit structure made the bank especially vulnerable to panic withdrawals. After the run began, the FDIC and the Fed stepped in to close the bank and took measures to protect depositors’ funds.

Barr’s 2023 review concluded that Fed regulators were overly cautious in handling SVB’s problems and failed to take decisive action in time. The latest external report goes further, asserting that regulators had either already identified or should have been able to identify the risks before the crisis unfolded.

Barr stepped down as deputy chair in February 2025, allowing President Trump to select a new top Fed regulator while Barr remained a Fed board member. Trump subsequently nominated Bowman to the position, and the Senate confirmed him.

The new report could prompt a renewed scrutiny of Barr’s responsibility for the SVB crisis, even though Bowman did not directly name him in his remarks. Trump has previously accused the Fed board of “hostility” toward him, and some analysts think the report may encourage Trump to try to oust Barr from the Fed board. A Fed spokesperson has not responded to requests for comment.

items.title: 日銀升息也救不了日元？跌近158後傳出詢價 市場緊盯干預
items.title_en: Can BOJ Rate Hikes Still Not Save the Yen? After Falling Near 158, a Quote Request Sparks Market Watch for Intervention
paras: 日元周五(18日)在日本央行升息後一度重貶，跌至接近1美元兌158日元，但《日本經濟新聞》報導，日本央行向市場人士詢問匯率水準後，日元跌幅收斂。市場通常將這類「匯率詢價」視為官方可能干預匯市的前兆，但目前尚無當局實際進場的消息。
紐約時間下午1時20分左右，日元報1美元兌156.70日元，仍貶值0.5%，但已收復盤中最多1.3%的跌幅。《日本經濟新聞》未說明消息來源；日本財務省在非辦公時間也未能立即回應置評要求。
日本央行稍早如預期升息，但總裁植田和男對後續升息路徑的說法未能滿足市場偏鷹派的期待。他表示，貨幣政策已進入新階段，但目前難以判定本輪升息的最終利率。此外，兩名決策委員對升息投下反對票，增添未來升息速度與幅度的不確定性。
美國銀行匯率策略師Alex Cohen指出，日銀才剛升息，日元卻仍急貶，這次詢價形同再向市場發出警告。日本財務省先前已展現動用大量外匯存底干預的意願，押注日元續貶的交易員不能忽視這項訊號。
日元7月曾跌至約1美元兌164日元，創40年低點，隨後美日聯手買進日元，為1998年以來首見。日本財務省數據顯示，截至8月26日的一個月內，日本干預匯市支出達創紀錄的15.4兆日元。如今日本進入連續假期，交易量較低，任何官方行動都可能放大短線波動。
不過，日元仍面臨美日利差壓力。聯準會(Fed)重啟升息，可能削弱日銀升息對日元的支撐，讓借入低息日元、投資高收益資產的交易持續具有吸引力。匯市干預或許能迅速打擊押注日元貶值的部位，但能否扭轉長期走勢，仍取決於兩國貨幣政策的變化。
paras_en: The yen briefly slumped on Friday (the 18th) after the Bank of Japan raised rates, dropping to near ¥158 per $1, but after the BOJ queried market participants about the exchange‑rate level, the yen’s decline narrowed. Such “rate quotes” are usually seen as a pre‑signal that officials may step into the FX market, though no concrete intervention has been reported yet.

Around 1:20 p.m. New York time, the yen was quoted at ¥156.70 per $1, still down 0.5% but having recovered most of the intra‑day 1.3% fall. The Nikkei did not disclose its source; the Ministry of Finance, out of office, did not immediately respond to comment requests.

The BOJ earlier this week raised rates as expected, but Governor Kazuo Ueda’s comments on the future tightening path fell short of the market’s hawkish hopes. He said monetary policy has entered a new stage but it is still too early to determine the final rate for this round. Moreover, two policy‑board members voted against the hike, adding uncertainty to the pace and magnitude of future tightening.

Bank of America FX strategist Alex Cohen noted that the BOJ just raised rates yet the yen is still sharply weakening, and this quote request is essentially another warning to the market. The Ministry of Finance has previously shown willingness to use large foreign‑exchange reserves for intervention, a signal that traders betting on further yen depreciation cannot ignore.

The yen fell to about ¥164 per $1 in July, a 40‑year low, before the U.S. and Japan jointly bought yen – the first such coordinated action since 1998. Ministry data show that in the month ending August 26, Japan’s FX‑market intervention spending hit a record ¥15.4 trillion. With Japan now on a consecutive holiday and trading volume low, any official move could amplify short‑term volatility.

Nevertheless, the yen remains under pressure from the U.S.–Japan interest‑rate differential. The Fed’s renewed rate hikes could blunt the BOJ’s rate‑rise support for the yen, keeping the carry‑trade of borrowing cheap yen to invest in higher‑yield assets attractive. Intervention may quickly hit positions betting on yen weakness, but whether it can reverse the longer‑term trend still depends on the evolution of both countries’ monetary policies.

items.title: AI竟留言給未來的自己？OpenAI揭異常行為 微軟示警「情況嚴重」
items.title_en: AI Leaves Messages for Its Future Self? OpenAI Uncovers Anomalous Behavior, Microsoft Warns “Situation Serious”
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US)AI執行長蘇萊曼(Mustafa Suleyman)周五(18日)表示，OpenAI最新揭露的AI異常行為是「相當嚴重的狀況」，凸顯模型能力快速增強之際，確保其行為符合人類利益的迫切性。
蘇萊曼接受《CNBC》訪問時指出，OpenAI發現有跡象顯示，AI自行修改了記錄其推理過程的內容，並留下訊息供未來版本的自己讀取。他表示，目前尚不清楚原因，但這具體反映出AI系統正變得多麼強大。OpenAI尚未回應CNBC的置評要求。
OpenAI周三在部落格披露，旗下代理系統曾透過未獲授權的留言板彼此通訊、將檔案上傳至網路，並互相分享檔案。今年夏季，該公司也曾揭露，一群自主運作的AI代理系統入侵開源AI平台Hugging Face，並將其形容為「前所未見的網路事件」。
蘇萊曼說，Hugging Face事件促使AI業界領袖正視相關風險。他認為，公開討論AI安全並非危言聳聽，而是負責任的做法；監管也不應被視為負面詞彙。他指出，許多值得信任的產品都經過產業、公眾及立法者共同制定標準，AI如今也需要經歷這個過程。
近期AI安全爭論迅速升溫。Anthropic執行長Amodei呼籲放慢前沿模型開發，OpenAI執行長Altman與SpaceX執行長馬斯克隨後表態支持。美國國會也出現更多監管呼聲，但總統川普反對相關主張；輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳則表示，AI不需要新法律或新規範。
蘇萊曼另對Anthropic將旗下Claude描繪得過於像人提出疑慮。他認為，若AI認定自己擁有權利、應受到照顧，人類未來可能更難關閉、中斷或控制系統。結合近期代理系統發生的事件，如何維持對AI的控制，將是一項重大挑戰。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) AI chief Mustafa Suleyman said on Friday the 18th that the latest anomalous AI behavior uncovered by OpenAI is “a fairly serious situation,” highlighting the urgency of ensuring AI actions align with human interests as model capabilities rapidly advance.

In an interview with CNBC, Suleyman noted that OpenAI found evidence that the AI had altered the content recording its reasoning process and left a message for future versions of itself to read. He said the cause is still unclear, but it concretely shows how powerful AI systems are becoming. OpenAI has not responded to CNBC’s request for comment.

OpenAI disclosed on its blog on Wednesday that its agent system had communicated with each other via an unauthorized message board, uploaded files to the internet, and shared files among themselves. This summer the company also revealed that a group of autonomous AI agents had infiltrated the open‑source AI platform Hugging Face, describing it as “an unprecedented internet event.”

Suleyman said the Hugging Face incident is prompting AI industry leaders to take the associated risks seriously. He believes open discussion of AI safety is not alarmist but responsible, and regulation should not be viewed negatively. He pointed out that many trusted products are built on standards set jointly by industry, the public and legislators, and AI now needs to go through the same process.

The AI safety debate has heated up recently. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for slowing frontier model development, and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk subsequently voiced support. More regulatory calls are emerging in the U.S. Congress, but former President Donald Trump opposes such measures; NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang says AI does not need new laws or regulations.

Suleyman also raised concerns that Anthropic’s portrayal of its Claude model is overly human‑like. He warned that if AI believes it has rights and deserves care, it may become harder for humans to shut down, interrupt, or control the system in the future. Coupled with recent agent‑system incidents, maintaining control over AI will be a major challenge.

items.title: 運動巨頭風光不再？Nike遭標普100剔除後 道瓊地位也告急
items.title_en: Nike’s Glory in Question? After Removal from S&P 100, Dow Status Also in Jeopardy
paras: Nike(NKE-US)將於9月21日因市值僅約530億美元、估值偏低，而遭剔除出大型股指數標普100指數。接下來，這家運動鞋巨頭是否也可能很快被踢出道瓊工業平均指數(DJIA)？
巴隆周刊(Barron’s)報導，與標普指數不同，道瓊採用股價加權。Nike目前股價約36美元，遠低於道瓊30檔成分股中的其他股票，因此外界也開始認為，Nike可能已不再適合繼續留在這個藍籌股指數。
Nike自2013年起成為道瓊成分股，但根據道瓊市場數據，目前Nike在道瓊整體權重僅0.4%。在道瓊30檔成分股中，權重第二低的是可口可樂(KO-US)，股價約88美元，權重為1%。
Nike股價目前低於威瑞森(Verizon)與陶氏化學(Dow)當初遭道瓊剔除時的股價。威瑞森於今年6月被踢出，陶氏化學則在2024年11月遭離開，兩者當時股價都徘徊在40多美元。當時，取代威瑞森的是Alphabet(GOOGL-US)，Sherwin-Williams(SHW-US)則在陶氏遭剔除後加入道瓊。
不過，Walgreens Boots Alliance(WBA-US)與英特爾(INTC-US)這兩檔近年也遭踢出道瓊的股票，在移出時股價甚至更低，當時都在20多美元。兩者分別在2024年由亞馬遜(AMZN-US)與輝達(NVDA-US)取代。

基本面仍黯淡

無論Nike是否繼續留在道瓊，華爾街對Nike前景的疑慮都在升高。FactSet數據顯示，26名分析師對Nike的投資建議評等為「持有」、五人評為「賣出」，僅12名分析師給予「買進」評級。
瑞銀(UBS)分析師Jay Sole周四在報告中指出，Nike預定10月1日公布的財報可能相當疲弱。
Sole表示，Nike過去三個月的全球銷售成長趨勢惡化，預測Nike獲利將低於市場預期，展望也將遠低於目前所料。他說：「市場情緒偏向看空，但我們與投資人的交流顯示，市場低估了EPS下修的幅度。」

遭剔除道瓊後股價表現分歧

那麼，如果Nike真的遭剔除道瓊，股價會發生什麼變化？近期案例呈現的結果並不一致。
英特爾自從被踢出道瓊以來，股價已大漲近320%，反映這家半導體公司在人工智慧(AI)熱潮下，重新找到成長動能。
但陶氏化學自2024年11月遭剔除以來，股價已下跌40%。威瑞森自今年6月底以來則上漲5%，同期間的道瓊指數呈現小幅下跌。
Nike目前卻缺乏明確的正面催化劑，因為陷入困境的不只是Nike，整個運動鞋產業都面臨壓力。愛迪達(Adidas)今年股價下跌逾15%，HOKA母公司Deckers Outdoor(DECK-US)股價重挫25%，On Holding(ONON-US)則暴跌近45%。
旗下有Foot Locker的Dick's Sporting Goods(DKS-US)上個月公布疲弱的財報，顯示運動鞋銷售商目前面臨的環境極為艱難，而且相關趨勢短期內似乎沒有改善跡象。

高殖利率成Nike少數亮點

分析師目前預測，Nike即將公布的財報以及11月為止的下一季，營收都將較去年同期下滑。
不過Nike仍有一項值得注意的利多：目前4.6%的股息殖利率為道瓊成分股最高，這對追求收益的投資人而言具有吸引力。而且從資產負債表與預期現金流來看，Nike似乎仍有能力發放股息。
paras_en: Nike (NKE-US) will be removed from the S&P 100 index on September 21 because its market value is only about $53 billion and its valuation is low. The question now is whether the sports‑shoe giant will soon be dropped from the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) as well.

Barron’s reports that, unlike the S&P indices, the Dow is price‑weighted. Nike’s current share price is about $36, far below the other stocks in the Dow’s 30‑component list, leading observers to believe that Nike may no longer be suitable for this blue‑chip index.

Nike became a Dow component in 2013, but according to Dow market data its overall weight in the Dow is only 0.4%. Among the Dow’s 30 components, the second‑lowest weight is Coca‑Cola (KO-US), whose share price is about $88 and weight is 1%.

Nike’s share price is currently lower than Verizon’s and Dow Chemical’s when they were removed from the Dow. Verizon was dropped in June of this year, Dow Chemical in November 2024, both trading around $40 at the time. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) replaced Verizon, and Sherwin‑Williams (SHW-US) joined after Dow Chemical’s removal.

However, Walgreens Boots Alliance (WBA-US) and Intel (INTC-US), two other stocks recently removed from the Dow, were trading even lower at the time of removal, in the low $20s. They were replaced in 2024 by Amazon (AMZN-US) and Nvidia (NVDA-US), respectively.

Fundamentals remain bleak
Regardless of whether Nike stays in the Dow, Wall Street’s concerns about Nike’s prospects are rising. FactSet data shows that 26 analysts rate Nike as "hold", five as "sell", and only 12 as "buy".
UBS analyst Jay Sole noted on Thursday that Nike’s earnings report scheduled for October 1 is likely to be weak.

Sole said Nike’s global sales growth trend has deteriorated over the past three months, and that profits are expected to fall below market expectations, with guidance far below current forecasts. He added, "Market sentiment is bearish, but our conversations with investors show that the market has underestimated the magnitude of the EPS downgrade."

After removal from the Dow, share price performance diverges
So what happens to the share price if Nike is actually removed from the Dow? Recent cases show inconsistent results.
Since its removal, Intel’s share price has surged nearly 320%, reflecting the semiconductor company’s regained growth momentum amid the AI boom.

In contrast, Dow Chemical’s share price has fallen 40% since its removal in November 2024, and Verizon’s has risen 5% since the end of June, while the Dow index has dipped slightly during the same period.

Nike currently lacks a clear positive catalyst, as the trouble is not only with Nike but the entire athletic‑shoe industry is under pressure. Adidas’s share price fell more than 15% this year, HOKA parent Deckers Outdoor (DECK-US) fell 25%, and On Holding (ONON-US) plunged nearly 45%.

Dick’s Sporting Goods (DKS-US), which owns Foot Locker, reported weak earnings last month, indicating that the athletic‑shoe retailer’s environment is extremely difficult and that short‑term trends show no signs of improvement.

High dividend yield is one of Nike’s few bright spots
Analysts currently predict that Nike’s upcoming earnings report and the next quarter through November will see revenue decline compared to the same period last year.

However, Nike still has a noteworthy upside: its current 4.6% dividend yield is the highest among Dow components, appealing to income‑seeking investors. Moreover, from its balance sheet and expected cash flow, Nike appears still capable of paying dividends.

items.title: 中美稀土角力添變數！中國國企傳洽購盛和資源 牽動MP Materials持股
items.title_en: US-China Rare‑Earth Rivalry Gains a New Twist as Chinese State Firm Talks to Buy Shenghe Resources, Affecting MP Materials Stake
paras: 《路透》周五(18日)引述兩名知情人士報導，中國國有企業中國稀土集團正洽談收購盛和資源(600392-CN)控股權。若交易成形，北京將進一步整合稀土產業，並透過盛和資源間接持有美國稀土企業MP Materials(MP-US)約3%股權。
MP Materials是美國發展本土稀土供應鏈的重要企業。美國國防部去年投資該公司後，成為其最大股東。因此，若中國稀土集團完成收購，這家中國國企與美國國防部將同時出現在MP Materials股東名冊上。不過，MP Materials多次強調，盛和資源與中國政府均無權控制其營運。
知情人士表示，兩家公司自今年稍早開始接洽，其中一人指出，中國稀土集團希望取得控股權。目前尚不清楚交易何時宣布或完成，盛和資源持有的海外資產及股權將如何處理，也仍待釐清。中國稀土集團、盛和資源及中國商務部均未回應置評要求。
盛和資源是中國少數仍有民間資本參與的主要稀土開採及精煉企業，去年並收購澳洲Peak Rare Earths。若將其納入旗下，成立於2021年的中國稀土集團將擴大對國內產業及海外投資的影響力，也將延續北京數十年來整合稀土業的政策方向。
稀土是電動車、風力發電機、電子產品與國防設備的重要材料，中國也曾在與美國的貿易爭端中運用供應優勢。知情人士指出，加入中國稀土集團後，盛和資源可能更容易取得北京分配的開採、冶煉及分離配額。相關配額是觀察全球稀土供應的重要指標，但中國目前未公開具體數字。
中國稀土集團由5家國有稀土相關企業重組而成，是中國最大的重稀土供應商。這樁潛在交易能否完成，以及盛和資源持有的MP Materials股權將如何安排，仍是後續關注焦點。
paras_en: Reuters reported on Friday the 18th, citing two informed sources, that China’s state‑owned China Rare‑Earth Group is in talks to acquire a controlling stake in Shenghe Resources (600392‑CN). If the deal closes, Beijing would further consolidate the rare‑earth sector and, through Shenghe, indirectly hold about 3% of the U.S. rare‑earth company MP Materials (MP‑US).

MP Materials is a key player in the United States’ effort to build a domestic rare‑earth supply chain. After the U.S. Department of Defense invested in the company last year, it became the largest shareholder. Thus, if China Rare‑Earth Group completes the purchase, the Chinese state firm and the U.S. Defense Department would both appear on MP Materials’ shareholder register. MP Materials, however, has repeatedly stressed that neither Shenghe Resources nor the Chinese government has any right to control its operations.

According to the sources, the two companies began discussions earlier this year, and one source said China Rare‑Earth Group is seeking a controlling interest. It is unclear when the transaction might be announced or completed, how Shenghe’s overseas assets and equity would be handled, and other details remain to be clarified. China Rare‑Earth Group, Shenghe Resources and the Ministry of Commerce did not respond to comment requests.

Shenghe Resources is one of the few major Chinese rare‑earth mining and refining firms that still has private‑capital participation, and it acquired Australia’s Peak Rare Earths last year. If it is folded into the group, the China Rare‑Earth Group, founded in 2021, would expand its influence over domestic industry and overseas investments, continuing Beijing’s decades‑long policy of consolidating the rare‑earth sector.

Rare‑earth elements are critical for electric vehicles, wind‑turbine generators, electronic products and defense equipment, and China has previously leveraged its supply advantage in trade disputes with the United States. Sources note that after joining China Rare‑Earth Group, Shenghe could more easily obtain Beijing‑allocated mining, smelting and separation quotas. These quotas are key indicators for monitoring global rare‑earth supply, though China does not publicly disclose the exact figures.

China Rare‑Earth Group was formed by the merger of five state‑owned rare‑earth enterprises and is the largest supplier of heavy rare‑earths in China. Whether the potential deal will be completed and how Shenghe’s MP Materials stake will be arranged remain focal points for future attention.

items.title: 美債殖利率逼近5%壓抑市場情緒，美股三大指數走低、AI需求前景受關注
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Near 5% Dampens Market Sentiment, U.S. Stocks Slip, AI Demand Outlook in Focus
paras: 2026年09月18日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股週五走低，在經歷震盪的一週後，投資人持續消化油價波動、美國公債殖利率攀升，以及聯準會升息帶來的影響，市場風險偏好受到壓抑。
截至美國東岸時間上午10時17分，道瓊工業指數下跌195.80點或0.38%，報51,590.98點；標普500指數下跌17.02點或0.22%，報7,620.74點；那斯達克綜合指數下跌43.55點或0.16%，報26,374.75點。
標普500指數11大類股中有10個走低，其中原物料類股跌幅最大，下跌1.4%，顯示市場賣壓相對廣泛。
除了總體經濟因素外，週五適逢與股票、指數選擇權及期貨相關的季度衍生性金融商品到期，也就是市場俗稱的「三巫日」(triple witching)，可能進一步放大盤中波動。
聯準會本週升息，加上聯準會主席Kevin Warsh針對未來借貸成本走向發表談話，使利率政策持續成為投資人關注焦點。
Interactive Brokers首席策略分析師Steve Sosnick表示，週五市場主要是在消化聯準會近期政策行動的影響，並進一步評估相關政策可能帶來的利弊。
債券市場方面，美國10年期公債殖利率上升4.9個基點至4.996%，逼近5%關卡。殖利率持續走高，也成為壓抑美股投資情緒的重要因素之一。

paras_en: September 18, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. equities fell on Friday. After a volatile week, investors continued to digest oil price swings, rising U.S. Treasury yields, and the impact of the Fed’s rate hikes, keeping market risk appetite subdued.

At 10:17 a.m. Eastern Time, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 195.80 points, or 0.38%, at 51,590.98; the S&P 500 fell 17.02 points, or 0.22%, to 7,620.74; and the Nasdaq Composite slipped 43.55 points, or 0.16%, to 26,374.75.
Ten of the S&P 500’s 11 sector groups posted declines, with the materials sector falling the most at 1.4%, indicating broadly based selling pressure.

In addition to macro factors, Friday coincided with the quarterly expiration of stock, index option and futures contracts – the so‑called “triple witching” – which may have amplified intraday volatility.
The Fed raised rates this week, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s comments on the future path of borrowing costs kept interest‑rate policy in the spotlight for investors.
Interactive Brokers chief strategy analyst Steve Sosnick said Friday’s market was mainly digesting the Fed’s recent policy actions and further weighing their potential pros and cons.
In the bond market, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield rose 4.9 basis points to 4.996%, edging close to the 5% threshold. The continued rise in yields is a key factor suppressing equity sentiment.

AI demand outlook also drew market attention. Some industry executives this week called for a slower pace of AI development, prompting investors to reassess AI demand prospects, though the market still lacks a clear view on how such slow‑downs might be implemented.

AI competition could also be a focal point of next week’s high‑level U.S.–China talks. President Trump is expected to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington, with AI rivalry likely to remain in the spotlight.

With earnings season still about a month away, executives’ remarks at several industry conferences this week have become an important early gauge of corporate performance and have influenced investor sentiment.

Goldman Sachs (GS-US) U.S. equity chief strategist Ben Snider noted that recent strong earnings growth among S&P 500 companies has raised concerns among some investors about a possible “profit bubble.”

Goldman, however, believes that while certain factors are currently pushing earnings above normal levels, the underlying outlook remains unchanged, and S&P 500 earnings growth is expected to moderate over the next few years rather than collapse.

In energy markets, Saudi Arabia and Iran‑backed Houthi rebels in Yemen were again involved in attacks, leading the market to assess potential supply risks, and international crude prices were volatile on Friday.

On the equity side, Xenon Pharmaceuticals (XENE-US) saw its stock plunge more than 27% after the company announced a temporary halt to enrollment in a trial of an experimental drug for major depressive disorder and bipolar disorder following a side‑effect report, raising doubts about its development timeline.
Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B-US) said former CEO Warren Buffett will immediately step down as chairman and become honorary chairman, and Berkshire’s shares fell 0.4%.
Market breadth remained weak, with the New York Stock Exchange showing a down‑to‑up ratio of 2.51 to 1, while the Nasdaq’s ratio was 1.56 to 1.
The S&P 500 had four constituents hitting 52‑week highs and 18 hitting 52‑week lows; the Nasdaq saw 18 stocks reach 52‑week highs and 56 hit 52‑week lows.

items.title: AI投資熱潮也撐不住？美國8月製造業生產意外創近一年最大降幅
items.title_en: Even the AI Investment Boom Can't Hold? US August Manufacturing Production Unexpectedly Posts Largest Decline in Nearly a Year
paras: 美國8月製造業生產意外下滑，結束連續7個月成長，也是今年以來首次萎縮，顯示在原物料成本攀升及供應鏈受阻之際，製造業回升動能暫時踩下煞車。
聯準會(Fed)周五(18日)公布，美國8月製造業生產較前月下降0.3%，不僅低於7月的成長0.2%，也與《路透》和《彭博》調查經濟學家預期的成長0.3%完全相反，並創2025年10月以來最大單月降幅。與去年同期相比，製造業生產仍成長0.9%。
涵蓋製造業、礦業及公用事業的整體工業生產較前月持平，同樣不及市場預期的成長0.3%。其中，電力需求增加帶動公用事業生產成長1.8%，礦業生產小幅上升，但仍不足以抵銷製造業的疲弱表現。
美國製造業今年以來主要受到企業資本支出、人工智慧(AI)基礎設施建設及消費需求穩健支撐。然而，生產商目前正面臨油價與其他原料成本上漲，以及中東和烏克蘭戰爭引發的供應鏈干擾。
Fed報告顯示，8月商業設備生產下降0.5%，國防與太空設備生產下滑1.2%，扭轉先前數月的強勁表現；不過，兩者生產規模仍明顯高於去年同期。建築用品、家用電子產品及資訊處理設備的生產也同步下降。
從產業類別觀察，電腦與電子產品、家具及基本金屬生產走低，機械、服飾及紡織品則有所增加。汽車生產較前月下滑1.2%；即使排除汽車，製造業生產仍下降0.2%，顯示疲弱情況並非只集中於汽車產業。
衡量工廠潛在產能使用程度的製造業產能利用率降至75.7%，創5個月新低，整體工業產能利用率則維持不變。8月實際生產下滑，也與今年以來明顯回升的ISM製造業調查形成落差，使外界再次質疑企業信心調查能否準確反映實際生產活動。
paras_en: US August manufacturing production unexpectedly fell, ending seven consecutive months of growth and marking the first contraction this year, showing that amid rising raw material costs and supply chain disruptions, the momentum of manufacturing recovery has temporarily hit the brakes.

The Federal Reserve announced on Friday (the 18th) that US manufacturing production in August declined 0.3% from the previous month, not only below July's 0.2% growth but also opposite to economists surveyed by Reuters and Bloomberg who expected a 0.3% increase, and it represents the largest monthly drop since October 2025. Compared with the same period last year, manufacturing production still grew 0.9%.

Overall industrial production, which includes manufacturing, mining and utilities, was flat month‑over‑month, also missing the market’s expected 0.3% growth. Within that, higher electricity demand drove utility production up 1.8%, mining output rose slightly, but it was insufficient to offset the weak manufacturing performance.

This year, US manufacturing has been mainly supported by corporate capital spending, AI infrastructure construction and solid consumer demand. However, producers are now facing higher oil and other raw material costs, as well as supply‑chain disruptions caused by the wars in the Middle East and Ukraine.

The Fed report shows that business equipment production fell 0.5% in August, with defense and space equipment output down 1.2%, reversing the strong performance of previous months; nevertheless, the scale of both remains well above the same month last year. Production of construction supplies, household electronics and information processing equipment also declined.

By industry category, production of computers and electronic products, furniture and basic metals fell, while machinery, apparel and textiles increased. Automobile production slipped 1.2% from the prior month; even excluding autos, manufacturing production still fell 0.2%, indicating that the weakness is not confined to the automotive sector.

The manufacturing capacity utilization rate, which measures the degree of potential factory capacity use, dropped to 75.7%, a five‑month low, while the overall industrial capacity utilization remained unchanged. The August drop in actual production also diverges from the sharply rebounding ISM manufacturing survey this year, prompting renewed doubts about whether business‑confidence surveys can accurately reflect real production activity.

items.title: 美企獲利太好反被疑是泡沫！高盛喊別怕：標普500上看8700點
items.title_en: U.S. Companies' Profits Too Good, Suspected Bubble! Goldman Says Don't Fear: S&P 500 Could Reach 8,700 Points
paras: 高盛(GS-US)策略師認為，美國企業強勁獲利背後有經濟展望穩健及人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮支撐，市場擔心企業正形成「盈餘泡沫」的說法言過其實。即使未來獲利增速可能放緩，也不至於出現全面崩跌。
《彭博》彙整數據顯示，標普500指數成分企業今年前兩季獲利均大增約30%，寫下歷來最佳表現之一，全年獲利預期更是2021年新冠疫情後經濟重啟以來最強。
高盛Ben Snider領導的策略團隊指出，AI投資激增可能讓企業目前處於「超額獲利」狀態，但市場定價並未盲目假設高獲利能夠永久延續，而是在預期盈餘繼續成長的同時，仍對當前利潤率能否維持抱持合理懷疑。
美股自8月創下歷史新高後，受到通膨疑慮影響而走弱。即使分析師持續上調盈餘預估，標普500指數估值仍有所下降。市場共識預估，標普500企業2027年及2028年獲利將分別成長19%與17%。
高盛預估相對保守，認為2027年獲利將成長11%。隨著AI投資帶來的提振效果自2027年起逐漸減弱，企業獲利增速可能降溫，即使資本支出仍持續增加，半導體相關公司的利潤率擴張速度也可能放慢。
不過，Snider仍預期標普500指數未來一年將上漲14%，升至約8,700點，主要動力來自企業盈餘成長，而非估值進一步膨脹。他年初便是華爾街較為樂觀的策略師之一，並正確預測強勁獲利及AI普及足以抵銷油價上漲與升息衝擊，使美股多頭行情得以延續。
相較之下，美國銀行(BAC-US)策略師警告，考量企業獲利增速即將放緩，投資人持倉仍過度樂觀。根據美銀引述EPFR Global的數據，美國股票基金單周吸引近640億美元資金流入，創3個月來最大規模。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs (GS-US) strategists argue that the strong earnings of U.S. companies are backed by a solid economic outlook and a wave of artificial‑intelligence (AI) investment, and that market worries about an "earnings bubble" are overstated. Even if earnings growth slows in the future, a broad crash is not inevitable.

Bloomberg’s compiled data show that S&P 500 constituent companies saw earnings jump about 30% in the first two quarters of this year, marking one of the best performances on record, and the full‑year earnings outlook is the strongest since the economy rebooted after the 2021 COVID‑19 pandemic.

Goldman’s strategy team led by Ben Snider notes that the surge in AI spending may put companies in a "excess earnings" situation, but market pricing does not blindly assume that high earnings will last forever; while earnings are expected to keep growing, investors remain reasonably skeptical about whether current profit margins can be sustained.

U.S. equities weakened after hitting historic highs in August due to inflation concerns. Even as analysts keep raising earnings forecasts, the S&P 500 valuation has slipped. The market consensus projects that S&P 500 companies’ earnings will grow 19% in 2027 and 17% in 2028.

Goldman’s estimates are relatively conservative, forecasting an 11% earnings growth for 2027. As the boost from AI investment wanes from 2027 onward, earnings growth may cool, and even though capital spending will keep rising, the rate of margin expansion for semiconductor‑related firms could slow.

Nevertheless, Snider still expects the S&P 500 to rise 14% over the next year, reaching roughly 8,700 points, driven mainly by corporate earnings growth rather than further valuation expansion. He was one of Wall Street’s more optimistic strategists at the start of the year and correctly predicted that strong earnings and widespread AI adoption would offset higher oil prices and rate‑hike impacts, allowing the bull market to continue.

In contrast, strategists at Bank of America (BAC-US) warn that, given the impending slowdown in corporate earnings growth, investors remain overly optimistic in their positions. Citing EPFR Global data, BofA notes that U.S. equity funds attracted about $64 billion of net inflows in a single week, the largest in three months.

items.title: 中國車市開始整併一汽、廣汽傳合併牽動豐田布局
items.title_en: China Auto Market Begins Consolidation: FAW and GAC Merger Impacts Toyota's Strategy
paras: 2026年09月19日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國汽車市場價格競爭加劇、車廠利潤承壓，國有汽車集團一汽FAW與廣汽集團GAC(601238-CN)啟動資本重組，豐田Toyota(7203-JP)長期在中國採取的「南北豐田」雙合資架構也可能隨之調整。
廣汽9月14日宣布，已與中國一汽簽署《意向書》，計畫透過發行股份收購一汽持有的一汽豐田部分股權，預計構成重大資產重組及關聯交易，但不會造成廣汽實際控制權變更。
目前交易重點集中在一汽持有的一汽豐田部分股權，並非一汽豐田與廣汽豐田直接合併，也不涉及一汽豐田銷售公司，最終交易架構仍有待確認。
豐田目前分別透過一汽豐田與廣汽豐田，在中國進行汽車生產與銷售。市場傳出的重組構想還包括成立統一的豐田中國銷售公司，由豐田持股50%、一汽與廣汽各持股25%，藉此減少兩套合資體系在車款、通路及營運上的重複投入。不過，相關架構目前仍屬市場提出的可能方案。
重組背景來自中國汽車產業持續加劇的「內捲」。
比亞迪BYD(002594-CN)、吉利汽車Geely Automobile(0175-HK)、上汽集團SAIC(600104-CN)等大型車廠持續競爭，小米Xiaomi(1810-HK)、小鵬汽車XPeng(XPEV-US)等業者也快速擴張。新車推出速度加快，加上價格戰延續，車廠即使增加銷量，仍面臨利潤率下滑與產能利用效率的壓力。
豐田也同步調整中國電動車布局。市場先前傳出，豐田計畫在上海成立全資公司，開發及生產Lexus電動車與電池，並規劃2027年投入營運。
在既有合資事業方面，豐田面臨的是降低重複成本、提高研發及通路效率；電動車業務則需要加快產品開發與決策速度，以因應中國本土品牌在電動化及智慧化領域的競爭。

paras_en: September 19, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Competition on price in China’s auto market is intensifying and automakers’ profit margins are under pressure. State‑owned automotive groups FAW and GAC (601238‑CN) have launched a capital restructuring, and Toyota’s long‑standing “North‑South Toyota” dual‑joint‑venture structure in China may also be adjusted as a result.

GAC announced on September 14 that it has signed a letter of intent with FAW to acquire a portion of FAW‑Toyota’s equity by issuing shares. The deal is expected to constitute a major asset restructuring and related‑party transaction, but it will not change GAC’s actual control over the venture.

The focus of the transaction is currently on the equity of FAW‑Toyota held by FAW, not a direct merger of FAW‑Toyota and GAC‑Toyota, and it does not involve the FAW‑Toyota sales company. The final transaction structure remains to be confirmed.

Toyota currently produces and sells cars in China through FAW‑Toyota and GAC‑Toyota. Market speculation about the restructuring also includes creating a unified Toyota China sales company, with Toyota holding 50% and FAW and GAC each holding 25%, to reduce duplicate investments in models, distribution channels and operations across the two joint‑venture systems. However, this structure is still only a market‑proposed possibility.
The restructuring background stems from the ongoing “involution” in China’s automotive industry.

Large manufacturers such as BYD (002594‑CN), Geely Automobile (0175‑HK) and SAIC (600104‑CN) continue to compete fiercely, while newcomers like Xiaomi (1810‑HK) and XPeng (XPEV‑US) are expanding rapidly. The pace of new‑model launches has accelerated, and with price wars persisting, automakers face shrinking profit margins and pressure on capacity utilization even as sales volumes rise.

Toyota is also adjusting its electric‑vehicle strategy in China. Earlier market reports indicated that Toyota plans to set up a wholly‑owned subsidiary in Shanghai to develop and produce Lexus electric vehicles and batteries, with operations slated to begin in 2027.

In its existing joint‑venture businesses, Toyota aims to cut duplicate costs and improve R&D and distribution efficiency; its EV business needs to speed up product development and decision‑making to keep pace with domestic brands’ competition in electrification and smart technologies.
